verdict.rationale: Polar documents payouts (withdrawals once a minimum balance is reached) and a balance view on the dashboard Finance page. Agents can reach orders and other org data through the official remote MCP server, the typed SDKs and the versioned OpenAPI specs. However, nothing shows payouts or balance transactions exposed via API, or any way to link a bank deposit to the charges behind it. Missing for 10: documented payout and balance-transaction API endpoints, MCP coverage of finance/payout data, per-payout breakdown of underlying charges/fees for reconciliation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
